items.Sentence: Fine screens will be provided upstream of the MBR tanks to remove particulate material...

The MBR system will consist of two parallel biological nutrient removal tanks and three parallel membrane tanks... biological treatment utilizing anoxic, aerobic, and deoxygenation tanks, followed by submerged membrane ultrafiltration.
The HAWPF RO system will consist of an RO feed tank, feed pumps, pretreatment (chloramine injection, sulfuric acid and antiscalant addition), cartridge filters, two RO trains...
The UV/AOP process will provide additional treatment... Chloramine will be dosed upstream of the UV reactors...

Post-treatment stabilization includes calcite contactors... Calcite and sodium hydroxide will be used for adjustment of pH, alkalinity, and hardness. Sodium hypochlorite and liquid ammonium sulfate will be added post-stabilization...
Odor from three foul air streams... will be conveyed to a single odor control unit consisting of a single-bed carbon adsorber...
HAWPF recycled water will be pumped to the product water tank for storage and equalization.
The treatment process at the HWRP consists of... primary treatment (coagulation, flocculation, primary sedimentation)
